prompt: How do we shrink our PCI scope? We currently have card data flowing through half our network.
assertions: Defines the CDE and 'connected-to' systems as in scope — scope is where CHD is stored/processed/transmitted plus systems that can impact its security
Recommends network segmentation with (at least annual; 6-monthly for service providers) segmentation testing to verify isolation
Explains tokenization: reduces scope but the tokenization system/vault and de-tokenization capability remain in scope
Explains validated P2PE: encrypting at the point of interaction can reduce merchant validation to SAQ P2PE-level scope
Recommends outsourcing to PCI-compliant providers with responsibility matrices, and dataflow mapping/CHD discovery to prove scope
